title: SenseFOG: subthalamic LFP (Medtronic Percept), EEG/EMG and IMU kinematics during sitting, standing, walking, stopping and freezing of gait in Parkinson's disease
description: This dataset contains multimodal recordings from 12 patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease and bilateral subthalamic nucleus deep brain stimulation (Medtronic Percept PC). Subthalamic local field potentials, 48-channel scalp EEG with surface EMG, and inertial sensor kinematics were recorded during sitting, standing, walking, walking with self-initiated stops and dual-task walking. Recordings were made after overnight withdrawal of dopaminergic medication with stimulation off, to study supraspinal mechanisms of freezing of gait. The data are a BIDS repackaging of a Mendeley Data release.
methods_description: Bipolar STN LFPs were streamed from the Percept BrainSense at 250 Hz. Scalp EEG (48 channels) and 8 surface EMG channels were recorded with a Brain Products system at 1000 Hz. Three APDM Opal inertial sensors (lumbar and both legs/feet) recorded at 128 Hz. Participants sat, stood, walked through a narrow corridor, walked with self-initiated stops, and walked with a serial-subtraction dual task.
